local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local elapsed=0;local period=0;local path=nil;local index=2;local done=false
local lastIndex=0;local best=math.huge;local stalled=0
local function stop(reason,health)
 done=true;print('RendingApproach checkpoint='..reason..' position='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..health)
 for _,obj in ipairs(nearby.actors) do print('RendingApproach actor '..obj.id..' '..tostring(obj.position)) end
 print('RendingApproach choice=done')
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if core.isWorldPaused() or done then return end
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during Hall approach')
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;period=period+dt;if elapsed<2 or period<.2 then return end;period=0
 local health=types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 if not path then
  local status,points=nearby.findPath(self.position,util.vector3(-176.61833,-914.53528,759.6),{{agentBounds=types.Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),includeFlags=nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.Walk+nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.OpenDoor+nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.UsePathgrid,destinationTolerance=100}})
  if status~=nearby.FIND_PATH_STATUS.Success or #points<2 then print('RendingApproach waiting path '..tostring(status));return end
  path=points;print('RendingApproach path selected count='..#points)
 end
 if health<94.4 then stop('injured',health);return end
 local d=self.position-util.vector3(-176.61833,-914.53528,759.6)
 if math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)<105 and math.abs(d.z)<64 then stop('door',health);return end
 for _,obj in ipairs(nearby.actors) do
  if obj.id=='0x1093ee1' and not types.Actor.isDead(obj) and (obj.position-self.position):length()<650 then stop('enemy',health);return end
 end
 while index<#path and (path[index]-self.position):length()<65 do index=index+1 end
 assert(index<=#path,'Path endpoint reached without the actual door approach')
 local distance=(path[index]-self.position):length()
 if index~=lastIndex then lastIndex=index;best=math.huge;stalled=0 end
 if distance<best-2 then best=distance;stalled=0 end
 local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(path[index]+util.vector3(0,0,65))
 local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
 if math.abs(ax)<.12 then stalled=stalled+.2 end
 if stalled>4 then stop('stalled',health);return end
 print(string.format('RendingApproach aim x=%d y=%d index=%d distance=%.2f position=%s health=%.3f',math.max(-80,math.min(80,math.floor(ax*256+.5))),math.max(-40,math.min(40,math.floor(ay*256+.5))),index,distance,tostring(self.position),health))
 print('RendingApproach choice='..(math.abs(ax)<.12 and 'move' or 'turn'))
end}}}}
